mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate progesterone's CNS effects and both agents can affect mood/behavior; progesterone may have minor effects on hepatic metabolism where tranylcypromine is metabolized.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression, mood changes, or behavioral alterations; counsel patient on additive effects and report unusual symptoms; consider alternative antidepressant if CNS effects become problematic.
